consequence.statement: Strimzi now performs Kafka Connect health checks against the new Kafka Connect health check endpoint; the changelog states no failure, rejection, or required operator action.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 adopts a new Kafka Connect health check endpoint (per proposal 89), changing the endpoint used for Kafka Connect health checks; the previous endpoint and any version or configuration conditions are not stated by the evidence.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The single changelog line names no Strimzi resource kind, configuration key, image version, or Kafka/Kafka Connect version boundary, so a condition identifying which environments run Kafka Connect health checks cannot be built from the evidence.
